steps.title: Beam bosses and web
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as spreader.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane. Two circles diameter 70 at 0 and 330 mm along Y, on the origin line, and a 30 mm wide bar joining them. Finish Sketch.
steps.note: The origin is on the front beam axis.

steps.title: Armrest post
actions: Sketch on the side face: rectangle 60 wide from 330 to 390 mm along Y, up to 260 mm above the origin, with a circle diameter 40 at its top (the armrest pivot boss). Extrude 8 mm, Symmetric, Join.

steps.title: Recline pivot arm
actions: Sketch a 30 mm bar from the post to a circle diameter 32 at 420 along and 60 above the origin. Extrude 8 mm, Symmetric, Join.
steps.note: Both backs either side of the spreader turn on this boss.

steps.title: Beam bores and pivot holes
actions: Hole: diameter 50 Through All on each beam boss (the tubes pass through).
Hole: diameter 12 Through All on the armrest pivot and on the recline pivot.

steps.title: Lightening holes
actions: Sketch a 24 x 130 slot in the post and a 210 x 16 slot in the web. Extrude Cut Through All.
steps.note: Every gram counts: each slot saves weight where the plate is lightly loaded.
